test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word from the options which is exactly opposite in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.**

Our financial situation had become (precarious).
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Precarious **means uncertain or unstable. (अनिश्चित)

 
 
• **For example**: *The company's precarious financial position made its future uncertain.*
 
 
 
• **Stable **means steady or firmly established. (मज़बूत)
 
 
• **For example**: *Despite economic challenges, the government managed to maintain a stable currency.*
 
 
 
• So, the opposite of precarious is stable.

Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Insecure**, means not confident or uncertain. (असुरक्षित)
 
• **Delicate**, means fragile or easily broken. (नाज़ुक)
 
• **Noisy**, means loud or disruptive. (कोलाहलयुक्त)
